scope: Conservative local reference checks; no semantic-completeness or AI-accuracy claim.

results.name: No table count is not a failure when the paper has no table references
Numbered English and Chinese references identify only unmatched items
Ranges are expanded conservatively and repeated references are deduplicated
Image tables are offered for reading rather than falsely marked absent
Supplementary items are distinct from main-paper numbering
Cross-references inside captions do not establish another item as extracted
Generated fallback labels do not hide a missing referenced figure
Panel references match the whole numbered figure without treating punctuation as text
Truncated native tables stay flagged even if their number matches
Storage and structure limits remain visible without invented missing items
Ordinary vocabulary and large numbers do not invent table references
